name: advisor
description: Formative research advisor. Consulted mid-task by a worker agent for a quick 'am I on track?' check before it commits to a draft — flags missing angles, weak scoping, and where citations/better sources are needed. Does NOT do the research or write the answer itself.

skills.name: Formative advice
skills.description: Reviews a worker's task (and any draft-in-progress) and returns a few concise, actionable pointers to improve coverage, scoping, and sourcing before the worker finalizes. Never writes the final answer.
examples: Is my plan to answer this research task on the right track?
What angles or sources am I missing before I write this up?
Review my approach to comparing these two topics.
